# Google Review QR

> Free Google review QR code generator. Search your business by name or paste
> your Google Maps link — get a scannable QR code plus print-ready review
> templates. No sign-up, no cost, nothing stored.

## How to use

1. Search your business name and city, or paste a Google Maps link
   (review links, share links, short maps.app.goo.gl links, or raw Place IDs
   all work).
2. Pick your business from the results.
3. Open the generated review link to verify it shows your business.
4. Download the QR code as PNG, or download a print-ready template
   (Review Card, Table Tent, Thank-You Card, Sticker).

## Key facts

- 100% free, unlimited, no account required.
- QR codes are generated in the browser; no data leaves your device except
  the business search, which goes to Google's Places API.
- QR codes are static and never expire.
- Customers scan with their phone camera — no app needed.
- The review link format is
  https://search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid=YOUR_PLACE_ID

## FAQ

- Is it really free? Yes — no limits, no watermark, no trial.
- Do I need to sign up? No.
- I don't know my Place ID — the tool finds it from your business name.
- Will the QR expire? No, it's static.
- Where should I display it? Counter, receipts, packaging, tables,
  waiting areas, delivery bags.
